problem: Web3 apps struggle to onboard users from many countries with local payment methods.
business_model: Payment gateway fees via API and SDK
product_category: Fiat to crypto on and off ramp

founders.name: Gajendra Khatri
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page; launch post says both founders have about 7 years of engineering and 4 in blockchain.

competitors.name: MoonPay
competitors.what: Fiat to crypto on-ramp for wallets and NFT sites
competitors.funding_then: Series A listed Nov 2021 by CB Insights

competitors.name: Ramp Network
competitors.funding_then: $70M Series B Nov 2022 (a few months after batch)

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating payment methods plus KYC and AML across regions is standard but compliance heavy.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded on-ramps offered the same API.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded ramps already dominated integrations.

market_need_then: Web3 apps needed local payment onboarding; YC launch post positioned Rampay as a bridge across regions.

branding.name_origin: Formerly Rampay per CB Insights; name origin not sourced.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found.

outcome_analysis: Payfura (formerly Rampay) joined YC S22 as a two person crypto on-ramp and raised about 500k. YC lists it inactive but no shutdown notice or cause was found in searches, so the cause is not public. The crypto downturn and strong on-ramp rivals are context but no source ties them to this company.
notes: Round rests on CB Insights (single database); VCBacked says August 2022 pre-seed. Employbl shows $1M, likely a data error. No company website listed. Metahill Inc link is single source.
